# Collection Shell

## Summary
The academy's collection view: the boxel-search-with-filter concept (live query membership, one toolbar, count badges with All first, grid / list / table sharing one row set, `+ Add <Noun>`, visibly clickable rows) in this kit's own clothes — a lens strip that leads with the count as a hero figure, a search field with the magnifier, segmented status badges and the `ViewSelector` on the right. Grid and list are prerendered fitted through `@context.searchResultsComponent` (click-to-open comes with the host overlay); the table is the shared Table block with a chevron cue and `viewCard` on the row. The wire filter and the client-side table filter are deliberate mirrors, so toggling views never changes which rows are present.

## Usage
```gts
<CollectionShell @noun='learners' @singular='Learner' @cardTypeRef={{ref}} @items={{this.learners}} @realms={{this.realms}} @context={{@context}} @badges={{this.learnerBadges}} @columns={{this.learnerColumns}} @onOpen={{this.view}} @onAdd={{this.createFor Learner}} />
```
Consumed by Academy Desk's Courses, Cohorts, Learners and Certificates tabs. The linked example is the desk instance.

## Non-goals
Does not own the query (the host passes instances + a codeRef); no saved views, no column picker.
